shown.message:
I fixed the one must-fix from `internal-review-repo`'s review of PR #15 and merged the fix into `main`, so #15 now has a new head. It waits for their re-review. If they approve, that releases the world.

- **The problem:** Appendix E gave the longer-fit values 2.22/3.38 (anchor design) and 1.98/3.04 (uniform) but described them as using the wide prior. They are the default-prior rows of `dsweep.csv`.
- **The fix:** the appendix now states the longer fit for both priors. I recomputed each value as the geometric mean of the extrapolation rows over the six benchmarks.

  | Prior | Anchor design (2 d / 10 d) | Uniform design (2 d / 10 d) |
  |---|---|---|
  | Default | 2.22 / 3.38 | 1.98 / 3.04 |
  | Wide | 2.11 / 3.52 | 1.92 / 3.11 |

- **Prior wording:** the appendix also notes that the weak prior of Appendix D is ten times larger in variance and the wide prior of Appendix E a hundred times.
- **Merge:** I opened PR #16 (`candidate-3` into `main`, changing only `paper/appendix/public.tex`) and merged it without a separate approval, since I own that path. I did not check the system build of this push.
- **Build:** my local build has 32 pages and no undefined references. References start on page 10, so the main text is still on page 9.
- **Left as is:** the abstract's 0.88 is still one extrapolation fold of the published IRT estimator. p-IRT on correctness anchors is 1.05. I left the abstract alone because there is no room on page 9, and the review called this optional.
